free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0: 100 requests daily, 3 articles per news request, global market news with entity metadata; the Market Stats endpoints allow 0 entities per stat request.
free_tier.notes: Each call to access financial news or analysis data adds 1 request to the daily usage. The entity-stats, trending-entities and time-series endpoints are documented as available on Standard and above. The next plan up is Basic at USD 29 a month for 2,500 requests daily and 20 articles per request.

per_object_cap.stated: 3 articles per news request on the Free plan; an article carries a short snippet of its body, not the body
per_object_cap.notes: A result set cannot exceed 20,000 articles; the source and entity list endpoints return 50 rows a page.

retention.stated: no history window is stated for the Free plan

interface_detail: REST over HTTPS at api.marketaux.com/v1 (news/all, news/similar, news/uuid, news/sources, entity search and metadata lists); the token goes in the api_token parameter; answers are UTF-8 JSON with dates in UTC
chaining: News articles tagged with the stock, index, currency and crypto entities they mention, with a sentiment score for each entity; the full article is fetched from the source URL by a crawler.

limits.value: 100 requests daily on the Free plan
unverified: a per-minute limit exists (HTTP 429 for too many requests in the past 60 seconds) and its size is read from the X-RateLimit-Limit header, which needs a token
3 articles per request on the Free plan; at most 20,000 articles in one result set

binding_note: 100 requests a day is met first; at 3 articles a request that is at most 300 articles a day.

identity_cost.detail: The pages say no billing details are required on the free plan.

reliability_note: Over the daily usage the API answers HTTP 402 usage_limit_reached, and over the per-minute limit HTTP 429 rate_limit_reached; a call with no token answered HTTP 401.
confidence_note: Quota, article cap, error codes and register fields are read from first-party pages; a call with no token answered HTTP 401, so the free token was not exercised. A call with a free token would move this to measured.
